name: AnimatedContent-TS-TW

frames.best_why: Three changelog cards sit fully in frame, showing the stacked result of the scroll effect.

tagline: Cards slide and fade into place as the page scrolls past them.
summary: A wrapper that slides its child in from the side or from below, fading and optionally scaling, once the child scrolls into view. The demo applies it to a stack of changelog cards.
appearance: A dark changelog page: a small outlined badge, a bold white heading and a line of grey copy at the top, then a narrow column of rounded dark cards. Each card carries a version tag, a white title and two lines of grey text.
behaviour: Each card begins shifted off its resting spot and invisible, then slides, fades and scales into place when it reaches a set point in the viewport. The move fires once per card and scrolling carries on normally.
demo_content: A spring changelog with cards for offline drafts, shared workspaces, command palette and faster search
search_phrases: cards slide in as you scroll
content fades up on entering view
elements animate in from the side
reveal cards while scrolling a page
staggered slide in for a list
use_when: Sections or cards should arrive as the visitor scrolls, giving a long page a sense of pace.
avoid_when: Above-the-fold content, which starts hidden, and long lists where repeated reveals slow reading.
customise: Wrap anything as children and set distance, direction, reverse, duration, easing, scale, threshold, delay, starting opacity and a fade-out after a delay.
weight_why: One GSAP ScrollTrigger and timeline per wrapped element, killed on unmount.

a11y.note: Wrapped content is kept invisible until it scrolls in, and there is no reduced-motion fallback.

issues: Body text inside the cards is dim grey on near-black and hard to read.
polish_why: The slide-ins are smooth and the changelog reads well; the dim card copy is the weak point.
title: Animated Content
